segment.source: Renders the smallest possible opening: a breadcrumb trail, the page title, an optional single line under it, and one action pushed to the far side. Use it for: legal and policy pages, contact pages, account and portal pages, form pages, any interior page that needs a title band rather than a hero. Prefer 'Category Hero' when the band introduces a list below it, and 'Statement Hero' when the page deserves a full-height opening after all.
